title: Account & privacy
intro: Manage your details, language and data. You're always in control of your information.

profile.title: Profile
profile.name: Name
profile.languageHint: Used for the app, AI conversations, voice consultations and emails.

password.title: Change password
password.mismatch: The new passwords do not match.
password.otherSessions: Other devices will be signed out.

consents.title: Your consents
consents.terms: Terms of use and privacy policy
consents.health: Processing of health and wellbeing data
consents.withdraw: You can withdraw your consent to health-data processing at any time by deleting your account below. MumWell cannot work without it.

data.title: Your data
data.body: Download a copy of everything MumWell stores about you (your account, check-ins, screening results, conversations, programme and consultation summaries) as a JSON file.
data.downloaded: Your data export has been downloaded.
data.retention: Chats are deleted automatically 24 hours after the last message. Everything else is kept until you delete your account.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.body: Permanently delete your account and all your data from MumWell. This cannot be undone.
delete.confirmBody: All your check-ins, screening results, conversations, programme and consultation summaries will be erased immediately. Enter your password to confirm.
